scope: Independent synthetic Czech ASCII-26 wordless monoalphabetic controls only
limitations: Artifact/code audit confirms separate gold-free input interface and recorded temporal order. No OS access log or sandbox proves the absence of unrecorded manual reads; retrospective receipts are evidence, not independent attestation.
The compile receipt was administratively recorded after grading; source equality and binary pin are verified, but that receipt alone does not establish executable provenance.

The inference process receives gold.json SHA-256 indirectly in INPUT_FREEZE; no plaintext/key values are exposed by argv or inference inputs. Gold resides in a separate folder, not an OS-enforced inaccessible store.

P06 timing probe is an extra same-seed diagnostic before freeze. Runner captures a score in stderr but never parses it; recorded configuration depends on elapsed time only. No evidence of probe-based tuning or ranking in inspected code.
Modern UD resource excerpts are disjoint in explicit document ID, full normalized sentence, and entire excerpt. Shared collections, author/genre dependence and near duplicates were not audited.
Six selected fixed-seed modern-corpus samples and three histogram shuffles do not estimate historical-case success probabilities or establish language/cipher-family identity.
Candidate-forward consistency establishes key/output compatibility; synthetic recovery is established separately by exact comparison to sealed known answers.
record_type: Summary of original independent audit, not a new public replay
